claim.claim-text: 1. A method of a user equipment (UE), comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the one or more signal types comprises sounding reference signal for multiple input multiple output (mimo-SRS), and wherein the method further comprises receiving, from the base station, an indication of a subset of mimo-SRS sent by the UE that may be used for UL positioning measurements.

3. The method of any of claims 1-2, wherein the one or more signal types comprises one of a physical random access channel (PRACH) or a physical uplink shared channel demodulation reference signal (PUSCH DMRS).

4. The method of any of claims 1-3, wherein the UE is configured to send at least one of the one or more signals of the one or more signal types to the base station starting in any symbol of a slot used by the UE to send the at least one of the one or more signals.

5. The method of any of claims 1-4, wherein the UE capability information message further indicates that a signal of one of the one or more signal types may be sent by the UE according to one or more of an inter-slot frequency hopping scheme, an intra-slot frequency hopping scheme, and a slot repetition scheme.

6. The method of any of claims 1-5, wherein the UE capability information message further indicates that signals of each of at least two signal types can be sent by the UE in one of a same time resource, a same frequency resource, and a same time and frequency resource, the at least two signal types comprising at least one of the indicated one or more signal types.
7. The method of claim 6, wherein the UE capability information message further indicates, to the base station, one or more of:
8. A method of a base station, comprising:

9. The method of claim 8, wherein the UL positioning measurement is performed by the base station as part of one of an UL angle of arrival (UL-AoA) positioning method, a UL-time difference of arrival (UL-TDOA) positioning method, and a multi-round trip time (Multi-RTT) positioning method, wherein the one or more signal types comprises sounding reference signal for multiple input multiple output (mimo-SRS), and wherein the method further comprises sending, to the UE, an indication of a subset of mimo-SRS sent by the UE that may be used for UL positioning measurements.

10. The method of any of claims 8-9, wherein the base station is configured to receive at least one of the one or more signals of the one or more signal types from the UE starting in any symbol of a slot used by the UE to send the at least one of the one or more signals.

11. The method of any of claims 8-10, wherein the UE capability information message further indicates that a signal of one of the one or more signal types may be sent by the UE according to one or more of an inter-slot frequency hopping scheme, an intra-slot frequency hopping scheme, and a slot repetition scheme.

12. The method of any of claims 8-11, wherein the UE capability information message further indicates that signals of each of at least two signal types can be sent by the UE for UL positioning measurements within one of a same time resource, a same frequency resource, and a same time and frequency resource, the at least two signal types comprising at least one of the indicated one or more signal types.
13. The method of claim 12, wherein the UE capability information message further indicates one or more of:

a maximum supported number of signals of the at least two signal types that can be sent by the UE for UL positioning measurements within the one of the same time resource, the same frequency resource, and the same time and frequency resource, a maximum supported number of signals of a first of the at least two signal types that can be sent by the UE for UL positioning measurements within the one of the same time resource, the same frequency resource, and the same time and frequency resource; and a maximum supported number of signals of a second of the at least two signal types that can be sent by the UE for UL positioning measurements within the one of the same time resource, the same frequency resource, and the same time and frequency resource.
14. An apparatus comprising means to perform the method of any of claim 1 to claim 13.

15. A computer-readable media comprising instructions to cause an electronic device, upon execution of the instructions by one or more processors of the electronic device, to perform the method of any of claim 1 to claim 13.
